title: How to Batch Cook a Full Week of Meals in 90 Minutes (Complete Guide)
description: A complete, step-by-step guide to batch cooking five dinners, prepping ingredients, and cleaning up in under an hour and a half.
transcript: In this video I'm going to show you exactly how I cook five full dinners, prep tomorrow's lunch, and clean the entire kitchen in ninety minutes flat, every single Sunday.
